name: agent-app
description: Build, evolve, operate, install, and import Agent Apps: full-stack apps an agent can drive through the A2App protocol. Ships the six framework skills (creator, modify, importer, operator, walk-verify, connect) plus the `/agent-app` launcher command that routes a request to the right skill (installing from the marketplace, importing, adopting, converting and exporting go to the importer), and directs the agent to the `agent-app` and `a2app` CLIs (`npm i -g agent-app-framework`).
